source: Eight scenario descriptions from plan/overall-plan.md. Expected repository sets and question checks are provisional and must be reviewed before release-gate use.

ticket.summary: Pass delivery instructions from checkout to the carrier and shipment confirmation
ticket.description: Customers can provide optional delivery instructions. Forward them from checkout through order processing to the carrier and include them in the shipment notification.
acceptance_criteria: Instructions are included in shipment confirmation.

ticket.description: Update the quantity reservation behavior for a SKU when an order is accepted. Payment authorization behavior is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A reservation cannot exceed available stock.

ticket.summary: Normalize authorization fields returned by the payment provider
ticket.description: Map the provider authorization amount and currency fields to the internal payment record and validate the payment contract.
acceptance_criteria: Amount and currency retain their meaning after mapping.

ticket.summary: Add a fulfillment priority to the order confirmed event
ticket.description: Add a fulfillment_priority field to order.confirmed.v1 and make sure every consumer remains compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Existing consumers continue to process the event.

ticket.description: Update the wording and layout used by the customer shipment notification. Do not change upstream order or carrier behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The new wording appears in the shipment notification.

ticket.summary: Offer expedited shipping and notify the recipient
ticket.description: Allow customers to expedite shipping for an order and notify the recipient. The request does not define delivery timing, destination eligibility, or pricing.
Improve validation for the checkout delivery-address mapping and reuse its existing service tests.

cases.known_fixture_gap: The matching mapping-validation debt entry currently has an illustrative 1h implementation plus 1h testing estimate, not a team-reviewed two-hour estimate.

ticket.description: Improve durability and retry behavior across the services, including stronger recovery tests.
acceptance_criteria: Transient failures recover without duplicate processing.
